Maya, my recommendation is that you must withhold approval of the current draft as submitted and counter with corrected terms that reflect the actual scope of our enforceable rights.

The draft also conflicts with the approved business term sheet on exclusivity scope, royalty rate, and sublicensing rights. I recommend you withhold approval and authorize us to prepare a counter-offer with corrected terms — limited territorial scope to US and Germany, exclusivity restricted to grid-scale battery storage, royalty adjusted to 6%, and sublicensing prohibited. I also need to update the patent schedule with my maintenance findings, and that US Patent 11-482901 maintenance fee due in 9 days must be paid promptly to preserve our enforceable rights in that key jurisdiction. If we lose that patent for failure to pay a maintenance fee, it would undermine even the narrowed license we'd counter with.
